name: dispatch-board
description: A side pane for Claude Code that shows where delegated work orders stand and what each lane has spent this month. Read-only.

command.title: Data command
command.description: A command that prints a board snapshot as JSON (see README). Run without a shell, at most 5 seconds. Leave empty to read agent-dispatch's state files directly.

intervalSeconds.title: Poll interval
intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between polls while work is in flight. With nothing in flight the board polls once a minute.

showTitles.title: Show titles
showTitles.description: Show each order's title, cut to 40 characters. Off by default: a title is the only free text the board can draw.

maxRows.title: Rows per section
maxRows.description: The most rows each section draws; the rest are counted on one line.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.description: Draw built-in sample data and read nothing. For screenshots.
